title: 16 Team Server and Cloud Admin
subtitle: The team server admin and Maude Cloud, redrawn for Maude 2 — one People list, an invite that is the approval, the app connected by a code, stats for owners, and an operator console that can make anything for anyone
brief:
udelej redesign hub admin cell ale i hub cloud.maude dashboard. Chci to mit v design maude-v2 at to hezky vidim jak to bude vypadat. Menilo se tam i spoustu veci jak na self hosted hub tak na cloud.maude hub

Projdi funkcionalitu a predelej i UX at se to dobre pouziva. Co sem osobne treba zjistil pri pouzivani na desing.studyfi.com (self hosted) ze zvani uzivatelu je celkem komplikoane a matouci. Musi se tam prihlasit, pak ja to musim potvrdit a pak stejne potrebuji vygenerovany token aby si napojili repo. Takze to bych chtel cele nejak udelat prehlednejsi

V cloud maude dashboard bych zase rad videl vic statistik a taky monznost masaz members a projects a zakladat nove dle libosti jako admin
